scripts.dev: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @atlas/frontend" "npm run dev -w @atlas/backend"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run dev -w @atlas/frontend
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run dev -w @atlas/backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run build -w @atlas/backend && npm run build -w @atlas/frontend
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run build -w @atlas/backend
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run build -w @atlas/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run test -w @atlas/frontend
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run test -w @atlas/backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:docker && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atlas/motor && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/backend
